study type: Cross-sectional analysis within a birth cohort
outcome: DNA methylation (DNAm) at 28 CpG sites of CYP2E1 in cord blood
cohort: The study included 570 newborns from the Boston Birth Cohort, representing an urban, low-income, racially and ethnically diverse population in Boston, Massachusetts.
finding: Detection of acetaminophen in cord plasma was associated with 3-6% lower average DNA methylation levels at 7 specific CpG sites and differences in methylation variation at 4 additional CpG sites in the CYP2E1 gene body in newborn cord blood.
cross-section timing: At birth, using cord plasma and cord blood collected between 2003 and 2013.
